items.title: What is the platform?
items.content: It is the set of tools our reps use every day to find homeowners, build proposals and track every deal from first conversation to install.

items.title: Do I need to bring my own tools?
items.content: No. Everything you need to quote, present and close is built into the platform, and training on each tool is part of onboarding.

items.title: Can I use it on my phone?
items.content: Yes. The platform works on a phone or tablet, so you have your proposals and your pipeline with you in the field.

items.title: How does financing work?
items.content: Homeowners can choose from several financing partners, and the platform shows each option side by side so the choice is clear and simple.

items.title: Who do I contact for help?
items.content: Your team lead and our support desk are a message away, and the platform has guides for the most common questions.
